[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for No-Bake Energy Balls, including ingredients and instructions:  
- Ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats, 1 cup creamy peanut butter, 1/2 cup honey, 1/4 cup chocolate chips, 1/4 cup chopped nuts (optional), pinch of salt, vanilla extract (optional).  
- Instructions: Combine ingredients, refrigerate for 30 minutes, form into balls, and store in an airtight container.
